name: Cloudflare Workers AI Free
free_limit: 10,000 Workers AI Neurons/day across eligible inference models (resets daily at 00:00 UTC)
watch_out: Free neuron allowance covers only eligible Workers AI models; requests above it fail until reset or upgrade to Workers Paid, which bills excess neurons.
